"''Alert General Hux. And stop that fighter!|Thanisson and Kaplan|audio=KaplanThanisson.flac|}} '''Thanisson''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[First Order]] as a [[Petty Officer]] on board the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Finalizer]]'', the [[flagship]] of [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]]. While on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] he wore a [[Color|black]] [[Clothing|uniform]] marked with the [[First Order insignia]], along with black [[boot]]s and a [[Comlink|intercomm]] [[headset]]. Thanisson had fair skin and blond [[hair]]. He was present aboard the ''Finalizer'' during the [[Attack on Tuanul|raid]] on [[Jakku]], and reported the [[Escape from the Finalizer|theft]] of a [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]] by the rogue [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn|FN-2187]] and the [[Resistance]] [[pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]]. Dameron and Finn then fired upon the [[hangar]] command center where Thanisson was seated, flinging the petty [[First Order officer|officer]] from his chair amongst the shattered remnants of the window in front of him. ==Biography== ===Jakku=== [[File:TFA_FirstOrder_Star_Destroyer.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Petty Officer Thanisson was stationed on board the ''Finalizer''.]] Thanisson was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[First Order military|military branch]] of the [[First Order]] during their [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[Resistance]], an offshoot of the [[New Republic]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], including Thanisson's appearance, to [[34 ABY]]. Thanisson held the rank of petty officer and was stationed onboard the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] known as the ''[[Finalizer]]'', where he was posted in the main control room for [[Hangar Six]] under [[Colonel]] [[Kaplan (colonel)|Kaplan]] and Chief Petty Officer [[Nastia Unamo]].[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]] Thanisson was onboard the ''Finalizer'' when it traveled to the [[planet]] [[Jakku]] in search of the retired [[Scout|explorer]] [[Lor San Tekka]], who held a piece of a [[Map to Skywalker|map]] to the location of [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]]. After the First Order [[Attack on Tuanul|deployed]] [[First Order military|forces]] to San Tekka's home village of [[Tuanul]], the explorer was [[Death|killed]] and the [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] was captured; however, the map was spirited away by Dameron's [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]], whom the First Order failed to capture. ===An unauthorized departure from Bay Two=== [[File:Hangar_Six_control_room.png|thumb|right|250px|The control room Thanisson was stationed in was destroyed during FN-2187 and Poe Dameron's escape attempt.]] Dameron was brought on board the ''Finalizer'' for [[Torture|interrogation]], but as the hunt for BB-8 began, the [[pilot]] was [[Escape from the Finalizer|freed]] by [[Finn|FN-2187]], a [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] hoping to defect from the First Order. The [[trooper]] brought Dameron into Hangar Six under the pretense of escorting the [[prisoner]] and then hurriedly boarded one of the [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter]]s in [[Bay Two]] of the hangar. When the pair attempted to take off, they discovered the [[starfighter]]'s support cabling was still attached, preventing their escape and drawing the attention of Thanisson in the control room. Thanisson immediately reported the unsanctioned departure to Colonel Kaplan, who ordered that the [[TIE series|TIE]] be stopped from escaping while [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]],''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' head of the First Order's military, be alerted. [[Squad]]s of stormtroopers carrying [[F-11D blaster rifle]]s and [[FWMB-10 repeating blaster]]s then attempted to shoot down the starfighter, but were unsuccessful as FN-2187 used the vehicle's [[Lb-14 dual heavy laser turret]] to blast many of them. The trooper then turned the [[turret]] on the control room, shattering the [[Viewport|windows]] in an explosion and throwing Thanisson from his seat while Kaplan and the other [[First Order officer|officers]] present tried to cower away from the blast. Once Dameron managed to disconnect the support cabling, the fighter escaped from the ''Finalizer'' and headed for Jakku, but was shot down by the [[battlecruiser]] en route and crashed on the planet's surface. ==Behind the scenes== Thanisson first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which was released in North America on [[December 18]], [[2015]]. He was played by British actor [[Thomas Brodie-Sangster]]. Thanisson was not identified in the film, but received a name in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film. ==Appearances== *{{Film|VII}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]] {{Ab|Star Wars: The Force Awakens (audiobook)}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *[[The Force Awakens Adaptation 1|''The Force Awakens Adaptation'' 1]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Thanisson}} *{{InsiderCite|165|50 Things to Notice in Star Wars: The Force Awakens|50 Things to Notice in ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''|reprint=1}} *{{BuildFalconCite|73|Starship Fact File}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|48|Weapons & Uniforms}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' {{CardGameSet|set={{FFGXW2|set=First Order Conversion Kit}}|cards= *{{FFGXW2|set=First Order Conversion Kit|cardname=Petty Officer Thanisson|ship=''Upsilon''-class Command Shuttle}} *{{FFGXW2|set=First Order Conversion Kit|cardname=Petty Officer Thanisson (Crew)}} }} *{{Databank|petty-officer-thanisson|Petty Officer Thanisson}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Thanisson |es=Thanisson |fi=Thanisson |fr=Thanisson |it=Thanisson |ja=サニソン |ka=თანისონი |ko=타니슨 |pl=Thanisson }} [[Category:First Order individuals]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
